report.interpretation: Open claims per adjuster, by adjuster region, as of the 2026-09-30 snapshot (status = 'open'). 'Why' asks what drives the Southeast gap. I tested staffing, backlog and recency, workload mix and data problems.
report.answer: The premise is real. Southeast adjusters carry about 51.5 open claims each, against 18.0 in North, 13.5 in Texas and 11.3 in California. The Southeast has 206 open claims, spread over only 4 active adjusters. Two of its six adjusters left in May 2026 (ADJ-016 on 2026-05-01 and ADJ-017 on 2026-05-15). Their claims are all closed, and none of the 206 open claims sits with a departed adjuster. Since May, all new Southeast claims have gone to the remaining four, so the region has about half as many adjusters per claim as before. Two further factors add to the gap. Southeast claim volume rose to 143 in August and 135 in September, from roughly 100 a month in the first half of 2026. The region also has a higher open share (10.1% of claims, against 5.7–6.6% elsewhere) and more older open claims (18 older than 90 days, against 5–7 elsewhere). Most of the gap is the capacity loss, with the volume rise adding to it. I did not test why volume rose. Most open claims are recent, because September claims are still in progress and the latest weeks are incomplete, so the number may fall as they close.
report.answer_sql: select c.region, count(*) filter (where c.status='open') as open_claims, count(distinct c.adjuster_id) filter (where a.leave_date is null) as active_adjusters, round(count(*) filter (where c.status='open')*1.0/count(distinct c.adjuster_id) filter (where a.leave_date is null),1) as open_per_active_adjuster from claims c join adjusters a using(adjuster_id) group by 1 order by 4 desc

findings.claim: Southeast has about 3-5x the open claims per active adjuster of other regions, with only 4 of 6 adjusters still employed.

hypotheses.evidence: 2 of 6 Southeast adjusters left in May 2026, so 4 adjusters now carry the whole region's open claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Open claims left stranded with departed adjusters
Higher claim volume or more bodily injury/liability claims in the Southeast
hypotheses.evidence: Volume rose in Aug-Sep 2026. Southeast has 45 open injury/liability claims, against 16-22 elsewhere, but I did not test why. Part of the rise may reflect incomplete data for recent months.
No duplicate claim rows were found. The only caveat is the incomplete latest month.

data_quality_issues.issue: Latest months are incomplete, because claims are reported late (about 79% of September claims reported so far).
data_quality_issues.impact: Recent open counts are still moving, and the total will change as more claims are reported and closed.
